title: Adaptive Palette explores how AI can help people who use AAC communicate.
ai-preview: For example, its AI suggests words, builds full sentences, and learns what matters to you.
privacy: The AI runs on your own computer, so your messages stay private.
welcome: Adaptive Palette helps you talk using Bliss symbols. Here is how it works.
input-area: Your message appears here, at the top.
symbol-grid: Below are the symbols. On this board, each one opens a folder of related symbols.
customize: You can set up your board your way. Here, some folders show pictures in place of Bliss symbols.
open-food: Choose Food to open the food folder.
add-symbols: Choose bread, then cookie. Each symbol you choose is added to your message.
word-predictions: Word suggestions for your next word appear here.
command-bar: These buttons move through your message, delete symbols, and add more meaning.
go-back: Back takes you out of the folder.
sentences-slide: Make Sentences: one way AI helps.
make-sentences: Make Sentences turns your message into full sentences. Choose one to say it.
next-steps: Choose Done when you have finished. Your message is cleared, ready for the next one. The next videos show each part in more detail.
